faq.title: Questions people ask before switching
faq.description: Short answers, based on what the product actually does today.

items.question: What is Answer You built for?
items.answer: It is built for teams that need a cleaner way to manage question content: create and edit questions, preview before saving, import batches with validation, browse the library, and reuse structured data later.

items.question: Can I import existing question data instead of rewriting everything by hand?
items.answer: Yes. The import flow accepts JSON, validates the whole batch, shows pass and invalid counts, and lets you fix problematic records before import. That makes migration much safer than direct bulk insertion.

items.question: How does Answer You help reduce publishing mistakes?
items.answer: Single-question editing includes a preview workflow, and batch import includes a check-first workbench with focused fixing for invalid items. The product is designed around review before commit, not blind saving.

items.question: Does it support recurring daily question sets?
items.answer: Yes. The random question workspace can generate date-based daily sets with business rules such as first-question handling, category constraints, history-aware reuse control, and diagnostics when the pool is not sufficient.

items.question: Is AI already generating questions or checking duplicates?
items.answer: Not yet as a live production feature. Today the product focuses on reliable editing, preview, validation, and structured reuse. AI-assisted duplicate detection and higher-quality content checks are planned as an upcoming quality layer.

tips.title: Tips for Getting More Value from

sections.title: Treat preview as a checkpoint
sections.description: Use the preview state to confirm wording, answer order, explanation clarity, and image display before saving. It is the simplest way to catch avoidable content mistakes early.

sections.title: Import in batches you can actually review
sections.description: Large imports are supported, but smaller logical batches make validation results easier to fix and safer to publish.

sections.title: Use categories consistently
sections.description: Category quality affects filtering, browsing, and daily random set generation. A disciplined taxonomy pays off across the entire product.

sections.title: Write explanations for reuse, not just for storage
sections.description: Clear explanations make preview review faster, improve downstream detail pages, and give future AI quality checks better material to evaluate.

sections.title: Reserve first questions intentionally
sections.description: The daily random set workflow depends on first-question supply. Keep that pool meaningful and refreshed, or generation quality will flatten quickly.

sections.title: Plan for AI quality checks now
sections.description: Even before AI duplicate detection goes live, keeping question wording, tags, and explanations structured will make that future quality layer far more useful.

seoContent.title: Why teams choose a focused question workspace like
seoContent.description: Because question quality is not just about writing fast. It is about reviewing clearly, importing safely, and reusing clean data across workflows.
seoContent.intro: Answer You is designed for the operational side of question content. It gives teams a practical path from drafting and editing to preview, validation, publishing, random-set scheduling, and external reuse. Instead of forcing everything through spreadsheets or ad hoc admin screens, it creates one workflow for cleaner question data. AI-assisted duplicate detection and quality checks are positioned as the next layer, not a fake promise about what is already live.

sections.title: A workflow built around review, not just input
sections.content: Single-question editing is tied to preview so users can confirm the final result before commit. That matters when question wording, answer order, explanation quality, and image rendering all affect trust.

sections.title: Batch import that helps fix problems before they spread
sections.content: The import workbench parses JSON, validates batches, keeps pass and invalid counts visible, and lets operators repair problematic records in context. It is a safer migration and maintenance path than blind bulk insert.

sections.title: Daily random sets with explicit business rules
sections.content: Date-based generation is not left to luck. First-question selection, category uniqueness, history-aware reuse control, and full diagnostic feedback are all part of the workflow so operators know what to fix when generation falls short.

sections.title: Question data that stays reusable after entry
sections.content: Answer You supports list browsing, detail views, editing loops, exports, and an external questions base API. That means data entered once can keep serving downstream products, workflows, and integrations.

sections.title: A better foundation for future quality tooling
sections.content: Today the platform gives structure, validation, and review. Tomorrow that same structure can power AI-assisted duplicate checks, overlap detection, and content-quality signals without rebuilding the whole workflow.

sections.title: Useful for teams before it tries to be flashy
sections.content: The value proposition is simple: fewer content mistakes, less manual cleanup, clearer publishing flow, and better reuse of question assets. The product earns trust by solving the boring operational parts well.

seoContent.conclusion: If your product depends on clean question content, Answer You gives you a stronger operational base today and a credible path to AI-assisted quality control next.
